newsitem.title: GERMANY: Man picks wrong number to dial for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Man picks wrong number to dial for drugs.

text.p: A suspected drug dealer dialled the worst possible wrong number -- calling a German policeman to order illegal narcotics.
Police in the southern town of Bayreuth said on Wednesday the man had mistakenly called a mobile telephone number given to him by police during questioning last year.
He proceeded to order 25 grams of the banned amphetamine Speed and arranged a meeting place for the handover.
The police arrested the man at the handover point on suspicion of small-scale drug dealing.
